file_sharing.hero_pill: File Sharing & Media Storage for Film Teams
file_sharing.hero_sub: Film productions generate enormous amounts of material. Files live in cloud drives, private folders, email threads, and messaging apps. Different versions circulate. Links expire. Teams ask the same question repeatedly: which file is the real one?
file_sharing.problem_title: Productions don't struggle with having files.
file_sharing.problem_title_highlight: They struggle with finding the right one.
file_sharing.problem_desc: Most productions rely on general file storage systems. They are reliable for storing documents. But filmmaking requires something more specific.
file_sharing.problem_card_title: These are the questions no one can answer.
file_sharing.problem_q1: Which file is the real one?
file_sharing.problem_q3: Where did that reference image go?
file_sharing.problem_q4: Did anyone get the updated script?
file_sharing.problem_tools_footer: …and no one is sure which version is current.
file_sharing.problem_bottom: This is not a storage problem. It is a coordination problem.
file_sharing.core_desc: One platform. The complete production media lifecycle. Everything your team needs — from upload to delivery — in one connected workspace.
file_sharing.core_feat1_desc: Files live inside the same environment as scripts and scenes. No context switching, no disconnected folders.
file_sharing.core_feat2_desc: One source of truth. Teams always see the latest version without chasing down which file is current.
file_sharing.core_feat3_desc: Share scripts, references, and assets instantly with permission controls that keep the right people in — and others out.
file_sharing.core_feat4_desc: AI supports visual exploration and asset generation within the project context. Creative direction always stays human.
file_sharing.cta_title: Keep Your Production Library in Sync.
file_sharing.cta_desc: When media storage lives inside the same infrastructure as the rest of production, your files stay organised and your project vision stays clear.
file_sharing.cta_body: Centralise your files. Protect your assets. Keep your production in sync.
